architecture: Auditable application resolver plus independently enforced default-deny client-egress boundary; neither component alone establishes transmitted-packet guarantee

boundary.not_count: Remote recursive resolver upstream traffic; do not infer from application calls
boundary.network_packets: Separately observe at client egress; count each outbound datagram or stream transport unit under approved precise definition

cases.AAAA: Independent QTYPE budget; no implicit parallel query
cases.CNAME: Each follow-up question separately budgeted; unexpected chain stops
cases.cache: Cache hit recorded distinctly, never equated with proved zero egress
cases.implicit_getaddrinfo: Reject or prove intercepted; otherwise BLOCKED

environment.runner: ubuntu-latest mutable; exact image identity and configuration required before authorization

independent_static_acceptance: Reject equivalence of resolver calls, DNS questions and egress packets
Reject hidden A/AAAA, CNAME, cache assumptions and any retries
Reject implicit resolver, fallback or unobservable egress
Reject packet counter overrun instead of stopping before further egress
Require immutable identity evidence rather than relying on ubuntu-latest label
Retain distinct DNS and HTTPS approval checkpoints and all false locks
